metaDescription: Order custom green lanyards and badges in bulk. Perfect for events and teams. Get a quick quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Green lanyards and badges offer a versatile way to align your branding with environmental themes, safety protocols, or seasonal events. Whether you need 3/4" woven lanyards for a corporate conference or antimicrobial options for healthcare settings, the color green stands out while remaining professional. Choose from knit-in, nylon web, or PVC styles, and add your logo with silkscreening or full-color printing. These are ideal for trade shows, school IDs, and volunteer coordination where you want a fresh, approachable look that still commands attention.
heroAltText: Bulk custom green lanyards and badges with printed logos, ideal for events and employee IDs.
